function.name: search_memory
function.description: Search the memory vault (USER.md, RULES.md, wiki pages) for pages matching a query.

function.name: read_memory
function.description: Read one file of the memory vault: wiki/<name>.md (exactly as search_memory or the page list names it), USER.md or RULES.md.

function.name: edit_memory
function.description: Edit the memory vault one line at a time. Call search_memory first and edit the page it finds; create a new page only when none matches. target: wiki/<Title>.md (knowledge, a how-to, a number worth keeping), USER.md (who the user is) or RULES.md. op: add (append a line; creates a wiki page whose text starts with '# Title'), replace (old -> new, old must be exactly one existing line), remove. USER.md and RULES.md edits are queued for the user's approval - say so, do not say they are written.

target.description:
wiki/<Title>.md, USER.md, RULES.md or skills/<name>.md (a procedure the user asked to keep; always needs their approval); its text starts with a frontmatter block: ---
name: <name>
description: <one line, when to use it>
---
then the steps

old.description: the one existing line to replace or remove

new.description: the line(s) to add or to replace old with

evidence.description: the #seq numbers you read that support this edit

function.name: read_ledger
function.description: Read the ledger slice this consolidation pass is reading, paging with `after` until it returns nothing.
